text:
jun park: Quick spike result: proposing a compact breadcrumb (collapse middle) + single parent nav group for Models & Endpoints. Key constraints: keep legacy links resolvable and preserve ?query + #hash. Prototype: https://sketch.redwood/compact-nav-spike

elaine wu: microcopy: parent label -> 'Serving and endpoints' (sentence case). Ellipsis button aria-label should be 'Expand path'. Sidebar collapse control aria-label -> 'Hide navigation'. Also prefer short source pill text: 'From docs' or 'From support'.

mike cole: routing plan: server returns 301 for external requests to canonical path (append original search/hash). In-app navigation uses history.replaceState to swap to canonical without adding history entries. We'll add X-Original-Path on redirects so client can show the arrival pill. I'll file infra ticket PLAT-4999.

samir (sam): a11y acceptance: 1) ellipsis button uses aria-expanded + aria-controls 2) expanded list receives focus on open 3) breadcrumb changes announced via aria-live='polite' 4) deep-link opened panels focus the panel header, not body, and don't auto-open very long panels. I'll own tests.

priya rao: docs will add a small migration blurb and maintain a public redirect table for partner links. Also request telemetry: deeplink_opened with origin (docs|ticket|other) and legacy=true/false so we can monitor rewrites.

jun park: UX decision: do not surface 'legacy' jargon to end users beyond a tiny non-technical pill. Power-users can use a permalink inspector later. For now keep it subtle.

elaine wu: design tweak: collapsed crumb should show short preview like 'org / ... / model-name' and reduced motion for expand. Tooltip for expand: 'Expand full path'.

mike cole: noted. PLAT-4999 will include replaceState behavior, preserve-fragment requirement, X-Original-Path header, and telemetry event. I'll ping eng-plat when filed.

samir (sam): add these to PR checklist and I'll validate aria strings before merge.

jun park: final checklist: update prototype (jun), infra ticket (mike), a11y tests (sam), docs blurb (priya). I'll post an updated demo tomorrow. :thumbsup:
